claims: ISIS is the Islamic State of Iraq and Syria.
ISIS is also known as ISIL.
ISIL is the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.
ISIS is also known as Daesh.
ISIS is a Salafi-jihadist militant organization.
ISIS emerged from the remnants of al-Qaeda in Iraq (AQI).
ISIS lost its territorial caliphate in Iraq and Syria by 2019.
As of 2025, ISIS has at least 15 branches and networks across Africa, Asia, and the Middle East.
ISIS operates clandestinely in Iraq and Syria.
ISIS attacks in Iraq and Syria were at "historically low levels" in mid-2025.
Islamic State–Khorasan Province (ISIS–K) has been particularly active in Afghanistan and surrounding areas.
ISIS–West Africa (ISWAP) has grown significantly in the Lake Chad region.
In March 2026, two men were charged with an ISIS-inspired plot to bomb New York City.
In February 2026, reports suggested a "mass escape" from a detention camp in Syria holding ISIS-linked individuals.
Abu Musab al-Zarqawi founded al-Qaeda in Iraq (AQI) in 2004.
ISIS re-emerged from obscurity in 2011 by exploiting instability in Syria.
In 2013, the group rebranded as ISIS.
In 2013, the group split from al-Qaeda.
In 2014, Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi declared a caliphate across parts of Iraq and Syria.
Operation Inherent Resolve is a U.S.-led international coalition.
Operation Inherent Resolve began airstrikes in 2014.
Operation Inherent Resolve aided in the removal of ISIS from all significant territory by March 2019.
ISIS follows a fundamentalist, Salafi-jihadist doctrine.
ISIS seeks to implement strict Sharia law.
ISIS seeks to establish a global caliphate.
ISIS is known for public executions.
ISIS is known for rape.
ISIS is known for targeting of minority groups.
ISIS utilizes suicide bombings.
ISIS utilizes vehicle-mounted weapons.
ISIS utilizes kidnapping.
ISIS uses sophisticated social media recruitment.
ISIS revenue sources have included oil production/smuggling.
ISIS revenue sources have included taxation.
ISIS revenue sources have included kidnapping ransoms.
ISIS revenue sources have included extortion.
Syria/Iraq is the core area of ISIS operations.
ISIS in Syria/Iraq is now reduced to insurgent cells.
ISIS-Khorasan (IS-K) is active in Afghanistan and Central Asia.
ISIS-West Africa (ISWAP) operates around Lake Chad (Nigeria, Niger, Chad, Cameroon).
